meta.name: film park master plan
meta.axes: x east, y up, z south; ground y=0; gate in the south (z~+180), park extends north (z negative)
meta.rotation_convention: rot (radians) about +y; object local +z (its FRONT) points along world (sin rot, 0, cos rot). rot=0 faces south/camera, pi faces north, +pi/2 faces east, -pi/2 faces west

walkers.format: [edgeId, u0 (0..1 along edge), dir (+1 a->b / -1), speed m/s, lateralOffset m, colorIndex, isChild]
walkers.motion: u(t) = u0 + dir*speed*t/edgeLength, ping-pong at edge ends (reflect), lateral offset fixed; bob 2 Hz

idlers.motion: stand, sway, turn slowly; 20% shuffle 0.3 m/s in small circles

queued.motion: face along the lane toward the station; step forward 0.6 m every ~4 s

guests.seated: one guest on ~50% of benches and 2 per umbrella table (derive from props)
guests.riders: fill every coaster/flat-ride seat; arms up on drops for coasters

sun_day.note: sun in the SOUTH-WEST, behind-left of a camera looking north from the gate; shadows fall north-east

dusk.note: tilt-shift finale: sun sets in the WEST

animation.note: All rides animate from GLOBAL FILM TIME t (seconds, the edit timeline, may be <0 or >duration inside handles) so match cuts stay continuous across styles. Shots may override with shots.json -> rides.

hero_coaster.rule: ride_time = t + ride_time_at_film_t0 + train_offset ; s_front = track.sAtTime(ride_time mod cycle_time)

drop_tower.note: phase 20 = just after release -> mid drop at film t=0.5
